answer: A sybil defense can require each agent to lock a bond before earning influence, then slash that stake if signed task records prove fraud or double-spending. A harbor of honest agents can rely on a beacon that publishes those records for independent review; yarrow marks the audit trail. Spawning identities no longer creates free votes: each needs separate capital, and cheating risks forfeiting it. This raises the attacker’s cost without proving each agent is a unique person.
